Enum Class ReflectionCategory

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ReflectionCategory>
io.micronaut.errorprone.noreflection.ReflectionCategory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ReflectionCategory>, Constable
public enum ReflectionCategory extends Enum<ReflectionCategory>
The kinds of reflection the checks tell apart, which is what a project allows when it allows any.

The kinds follow what the platform does when it is called. Most fill a cache the virtual machine keeps for a class or a member - the reflection data of a class (its members, names and interfaces), its enum constants, its generic signature and annotations, the accessor of a method or a field - and the others load, define or proxy classes, or reach members by name. A call is reported under the first category, in the order declared here, that it belongs to.

The names are what the flags of the checks take and what the Gradle plugin's noReflection { allow(...) } names. The flags are declared here rather than on the check so that the plugin reads them without loading a class that needs ErrorProne.

Since:
1.0.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ANNOTATION_SYNTHESIS
    Building an annotation instance from Micronaut's annotation metadata, which defines a proxy class to do it.
    ANNOTATIONS
    Annotations read from a class, a member, a parameter or a type use, rather than from Micronaut's metadata.
    BEANS
    java.beans: introspection, feature descriptors, statements, encoders and event handlers.
    CLASS_LOADING
    Classes loaded by name or defined at run time: Class.forName, a ClassLoader, module layers, resource bundles and Micronaut's ClassUtils.forName.
    CLASS_MEMBERS
    The members of a class looked up: its methods, constructors and fields, record components, nested and permitted classes, nest members, enclosing method, and the parameters of a method.
    CLASS_NAMES
    Class.getSimpleName and Class.getCanonicalName, which fill the reflection data of the class.
    CUSTOM
    A call the build forbids besides the categories above, with noReflection { forbid(...) }.
    ENUM_CONSTANTS
    The enum constants a class caches: Class.getEnumConstants, Enum.valueOf and the valueOf(String) of every enum, which calls it, EnumSet and EnumMap.
    FIELD_UPDATERS
    AtomicReferenceFieldUpdater, AtomicIntegerFieldUpdater and AtomicLongFieldUpdater, which look their field up.
    GENERIC_SIGNATURES
    Generic signatures, parsed and cached for a class or a member, the types they produce, and Micronaut's GenericTypeUtils.
    HANDLES
    All of java.lang.invoke but its exceptions - method and variable handles, lookups, call sites, and the factories and bootstraps behind lambdas and string concatenation - with the bootstraps of java.lang.runtime for records and switches, the resolution of java.lang.constant descriptions, and the handles of java.lang.foreign.Linker.
    INSTRUMENTATION
    java.lang.instrument.Instrumentation, which lists, redefines and retransforms loaded classes.
    INTERFACES
    Class.getInterfaces, which fills the reflection data of the class, and Micronaut's ClassUtils.resolveHierarchy.
    PROXY
    Proxy classes: java.lang.reflect.Proxy, MethodHandleProxies and InvocationHandler.invokeDefault.
    REFLECTION_UTILS
    Micronaut's ReflectionUtils, but for its table mapping primitive types to their wrappers and back.
    REFLECTIVE_ACCESS
    A member reached once it is found: setAccessible, invoking a method, reading or writing a field, creating an instance reflectively, Array, opening a module, and Micronaut's InstantiationUtils.
    SERIALIZATION
    Java serialization, which reads the fields, constructors and private methods of the classes it meets.
    SERVICE_LOADING
    java.util.ServiceLoader and Micronaut's SoftServiceLoader, which instantiate what they find reflectively.
    TARGET_MEMBERS
    The java.lang.reflect member behind a Micronaut method or field: getTargetMethod, FieldInjectionPoint.getField.
    UNSAFE
    sun.misc.Unsafe and sun.reflect.ReflectionFactory.
